GENERIC MARKING PRINCIPLE 2: (not whole Marks half awarded marks, or other marks are fractions). always GENERIC MARKING PRINCIPLE 3: : positively Marks must be awarded  marks are awarded for correct/valid answers, as defined in the mark scheme.
